goal: Avoid copying the unbroadcast transaction ID set just to count its size in getmempoolinfo
Reduces mempool lock hold time for nodes tracking unbroadcast transactions
reviewability: No blocking issues or changes pending
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Tested and supported for avoiding copying the set on every getmempoolinfo call (l0rinc)
Approvals on the latest update addressing documentation comments (davidgumberg, maflcko)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because copying unbroadcast transaction IDs under the mempool lock is eliminated for size queries
The benefit is minor under normal conditions because unbroadcast sets are typically small
